value.rationale: The joint matrix constant depends sharply on three independent natural resources: sample count n, geometric valence m, and target radius rho. The complete family of optimal constants applies to nonproper image-constrained maps, which the degree-specific published improvement does not cover, and is a substantive constraint on simultaneous derivative interpolation data. The sharpness mechanism changes from near-boundary fibers in inner-map examples to collision near an interior branch point when rho<1. This supplies a natural complete classification rather than a small numerical adjustment to an isolated case.
